def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("black car")
    if not car_patches: return image_patch
    
    road_patches = image_patch.find("road")
    if not road_patches: return car_patches[0]
    
    road_center = sum(r.horizontal_center for r in road_patches) / len(road_patches)
    opposite_side = [c for c in car_patches if c.horizontal_center < road_center]
    
    return opposite_side[0] if opposite_side else car_patches[0]
